activities.name: PeekBatch
activities.description: Read messages using provider visibility behavior.

coverage.notes: Concrete has this activity branch; PeekBatch forwards original Plan into ReadBatch, inheriting its visibility behavior and reads. HandleMessage can parse fallback Config.MessageText, but decoded payload fields are generated data, not incoming Plan children. Signal/jacket addresses, messages, service responses and recursive other-adapter reads are excluded.
